name: image-watermark
description: Add the same text or logo watermark to a whole folder of photos in one go. Choose the corner (or tile it across the picture), size, opacity, colour and margin — sizes scale with each photo, so portrait and landscape shots look consistent. Nudge, resize or skip individual photos, preview the results, then export watermarked copies as JPEG or PNG. Your originals stay untouched. Runs locally; no upload or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 一次给整个文件夹的照片加上统一的文字或 Logo 水印。可以选角落位置或者整张平铺，设大小、不透明度、颜色和边距；大小按每张照片自动换算，横图竖图看起来一致。单张照片可以微调位置、缩放或跳过，先预览再导出 JPEG 或 PNG 副本，原图不动。在本地运行，不上传，无需 API 密钥。
